verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of Workers CPU-time or wall-clock execution limits. The only figures (30s CPU on free, 15 min on paid) come from a community commenter, not the product's own docs. Docs-15 covers billing (charging for compute rather than wall time), and Workflows' multi-week state persistence is a separate feature; neither publishes per-invocation limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
